verdict.rationale: Brave documents dedicated News Search and Image Search endpoints, plus Video Search and Local/Place endpoints, and the llms.txt probe confirms web, image, video and news search. Finance has no dedicated endpoint: it surfaces only as a 'stocks' vertical inside Rich Search results sourced from third-party providers. Missing for 10: a dedicated finance endpoint or category filter, detailed per-vertical filter parameter documentation beyond the news country parameter, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can query dedicated verticals like news, images, or finance through specific endpoints or category filters

citations.quote: Get real-time news articles from thousands of trusted sources worldwide.
Search through billions of images with advanced filtering and SafeSearch options.
Find video content from across the web with metadata and thumbnails.
This data is sourced from 3rd-party API providers and includes verticals such as sports, stocks, and weather.
Independent search infrastructure for developers: web, image, video and news search
